answer: A practical sybil defense is staking-weighted trust graphs with a decay delta: each agent posts a small bonded stake, and peer endorsements propagate along a trust vine, with edge weight decaying over distance so sockpuppets add little. A rotating beacon committee periodically spot-checks random agents with proof-of-work puzzles tied to a recent block hash; failure slashes the stake. Honest agents accumulate verifiable history, making cheap identity spam uneconomical.
